stages.stage: Determine if the file is a source file
stages.criteria: The file contains function definitions, class references, imports, and executable code structure typical of source code.

description: This file implements security-related functionalities such as password hashing, JWT token creation, user authentication, role-based access control, and admin user initialization for a FastAPI application.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str)
methods.description: Verifies whether the provided plain password matches the hashed password using bcrypt.

methods.name: str get_password_hash(password: str)
methods.description: Generates a bcrypt hash for the provided password.

methods.name: str create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None)
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with an expiration time based on provided data and optional expiry delta.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user_by_username(db: Session, username: str)
methods.description: Queries the database for a user matching the given username.

methods.name: Optional[User] authenticate_user(db: Session, username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user by username and password, returning the User object if valid.

methods.name: User get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves the current user based on provided JWT token; raises HTTP 401 if validation fails.

methods.name: require_roles(required_roles: List[str])
methods.description: Factory function that returns a dependency to enforce role-based access control.

methods.name: create_default_admin_if_missing()
methods.description: Checks if any users exist; if none, creates a default admin user with preset credentials.

ctags.name: authenticate_user
ctags.pattern: /^def authenticate_user(db: Session, username: str, password: str) -> Optional[User]:$/

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None) -> str:$/

ctags.name: get_current_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -/
